description: Hyper Suprime-Cam is Subaru's prime-focus mosaic camera, with 104 science CCDs covering a 1.5-degree-diameter field at 0.17 arcsec per pixel. The open-use broad-band filters on the Subaru sensitivity page are g, r2, i2, z and Y, with the earlier r and i filters still documented.
facility_description: Subaru Telescope is an 8.2-metre optical-infrared telescope near the summit of Maunakea, Hawaiʻi, operated by the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan.
notes: The sensitivity page, fetched 20 July 2026 update, heads the broad-band sensitivity column 'Sensitivity (AB mag)' for g, r2, i2, z, Y and the parenthetical older r and i rows. That heading is not a full sentence; it is the column label on the page. No PhotSystem is set: the filter page does not say SDSS in prose. Kawanomoto et al. 2018, PASJ, 70, 66, is the filter paper named on the HSC citation page. Its abstract, read from the Crossref record for doi:10.1093/pasj/psy056, says the paper describes five broad-band filters and one narrow-band filter and that the broad-band set follows Suprime-Cam's SDSS g', r', i', z' filters and Y filter. The ADS abstract page returned a captcha and the OUP PDF returned HTTP 403, so the Crossref abstract is the quote used for bands.*.references and the SDSS wording is not copied into PhotSystem. The same abstract distinguishes Y from the SDSS primed filters, so Y is not given PhotSystem. Miyazaki et al. 2018, PASJ, 70, S1, is requested on the citation page, but the article page was not retrieved, so that bibcode is omitted. The citation page also names Komiyama et al. 2018 and Furusawa et al. 2018; those articles were not opened. User-filter acknowledgements on the sensitivity page apply to narrow-band and special filters, not to g, r, i, z or Y. The copyright sentence does not clearly allow redistribution of the ASCII curves. The acknowledgement sentence is copied from the HSC citations page.

r.Comments: The open-use r filter was replaced by HSC-r2 on 28 July 2016 HST; HSC-r was the one mainly used until 11 July 2016 HST.

i.Comments: The open-use i filter was replaced by HSC-i2 in February 2016; HSC-i was the one mainly used until January 2016.
